source.capture_method: The published openadapt-tray package running live in the macOS menu bar with its real menu open, captured with the macOS `screencapture` utility and cropped. A neutral dark window was placed behind the menu before capture; the menu bar, icon, and menu are unmodified. The pynput global-hotkey listener was not started (it requires macOS Input Monitoring permission unavailable to the capture session); all other components ran as shipped. State shown is the real standalone state: no desktop companion process was running and sync is offline.
